title: Budget
description: Model for budget. Contains information about the budget, and when it last was run.

enabled.description: Whether budget is enabled or not

limit.description: Limit of the budget in Wh, or currency (depending on unit)

suggested_limit.description: If user want to set up a new budget this value could be used as a suggested limit. Only returned if a forecast could be made

config.description: Configuration for how the budget limit is determined. Returned when the budget is enabled.

mode.description:
How the budget limit is set.
- `manual`: the limit is a fixed value provided by the client.
- `auto`: the limit is derived automatically from the forecast at the start of each period as `forecast * (1 + margin_percent / 100)`. The derived limit is frozen for the duration of the period.

margin_percent.description: Percentage applied over the forecast when mode is 'auto'. Clamped server-side to [-50, 50]. Defaults to 20. Null when mode is 'manual'.

series.description: Cumulative consumption and forecast for the current budget period, one value per resolution step. Returned when the budget is enabled and a run has produced data.

consumption_cumulative.description: Cumulative actual consumption at each step from period start. Steps with no data yet are null.

forecast_cumulative.description: Cumulative forecasted consumption at each step to the end of the period.

status.description: Contains status about last run. Returned when the budget is enabled.

code.description: Indicates whether last run was successful or not.

value.description: Accumulative value between period start and data_until, available if code 'ok'.

forecast.description: Forecast of value at end of period, available if code 'ok' and if a forecast could be made.

period_start.description: Start of the period, available if code 'ok'.

period_end.description: End of the period, available if code 'ok'.

data_until.description: Latest data value (exclusive), available if code 'ok'.

action.description: Available if code is 'not_ok'. Indicates what went wrong during last run
